title: Kennedy delegation tours western nuclear facilities after Cuban missile crisis
place_text: Los Alamos and western US nuclear installations

plain: After the Cuban missile crisis of 1962, President John F. Kennedy led a group on a tour of Los Alamos and other nuclear sites in the western United States. A former Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell tells Michels this, crediting the researcher Jeff Cruickshank, who listed who went: Kennedy and Vice President Lyndon B. Johnson, along with names such as the national security adviser McGeorge Bundy and the Air Force general Curtis LeMay. McConnell raises it because a trip of such senior people to these sites suggests they were being shown something important.
